liaison_1.speaker: MARU
liaison_1.text: You got the file on air. Out here, that's not nothing.

liaison_2.speaker: MARU
liaison_2.text: His men have this block pinned. Hold the transmitter and let the arrest air.

liaison_3.speaker: MARU
liaison_3.text: One question before you bleed for this building - who are you fighting for?

liaison_4_resp_1.speaker: BIRIBEL
liaison_4_resp_1.text: Then hold the line. Order is all that's between this city and the pit.

liaison_4_resp_2.speaker: BIRIBEL
liaison_4_resp_2.text: Good answer. Tools get pointed at the people too - remember that.

liaison_4.speaker: BIRIBEL
liaison_4.text: The state, or the people inside it?

choices.label: The state. It outlasts every man who wears it.
The people. The state is just the tool we point.
